findings.title: Direct LLM provider calls bypass Model Router in emergency alert pipeline

evidence.observation: Emergency alert module invokes call_gemini and call_mistral directly via environment API keys rather than querying Model Router

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert inference to request completions via Model Router task types instead of direct provider SDK calls

findings.expected_benefit: Centralizes model governance, rate limiting, and observability across intelligence services

findings.title: Model Router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model Router is reachable on port 8891 but call_log_exists evaluates to false at /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Verify directory permissions and ensure call_log.jsonl is created and flushed on router invocations

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into latency, task volumes, token usage, and router failures
